title: Local scalar-profile radial gradient and Laplacian
source_anchor: ASTIS original canonical-library mathematical specification; source consumers HFT radial power/log and retained Proposition1.18
target_statement:
theorem radial_gradient_laplacian
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a x : E) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (‖x - a‖ ^ 2)) :
    gradient (fun z : E => g (‖z - a‖ ^ 2)) x =
      (2 * deriv g (‖x - a‖ ^ 2)) • (x - a) ∧
    Laplacian.laplacian (fun z : E => g (‖z - a‖ ^ 2)) x =
      4 * (‖x - a‖ ^ 2) * deriv (deriv g) (‖x - a‖ ^ 2) +
      2 * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) * deriv g (‖x - a‖ ^ 2)
